the engineering spine is reported unchanged, with its owner named, and is never presented as closed while it is not

findings.note: CEP-006 V.1 and CEP-007 V.1 both name the precondition as rooted-and-closed traceability under CEP-001 Article XVIII, which requires upward rooting, downward evidence, closure and zero orphans. The located measurement service instead reports one gap per artifact whose thirteen schema lanes are not all populated. Both are legitimate; they are not the same obligation, and only the first is a constitutional precondition. Closed by measuring them separately and reporting each against its own owner.
findings.title: The constitutional traceability obligation and the thirteen-lane engineering spine were conflated under one word

findings.note: The located relationship vocabulary maps labels to lanes. Measured from that vocabulary, several lanes of the thirteen-stage schema are named by no label at all, so no artifact can populate them through the located generator by any means. A predicate requiring all thirteen therefore cannot be satisfied by any legal repository state. This is recorded, quantified and referred to the vocabulary owner; it is not remediated here, because adding a label to the located vocabulary is a change to that owner's code and to the corpus it generates.
findings.title: Five of the thirteen spine lanes are named by no located label, so the completeness predicate has no reachable satisfying state

findings.note: The certified corpus already carries typed structural edges whose subject lanes the located vocabulary declares, but the generator writes lane entries only for edges derived from front-matter metadata rows, never for the structural edges it emits itself. The derivation register quantifies exactly how many lane entries the existing edges would support, citing each edge identifier. This programme writes none of them: the corpus is generated by its located owner and is read-only here. The headroom is recorded so the closure is a decision for that owner rather than an unknown.
findings.title: Located structural edges already support lane entries the generator does not write
